blurb: Guests rent various boats and personal watercraft to enjoy water sports, cruising, and sightseeing on Okanagan Lake. Options include jet skis, bowriders, a surfboat, and a pontoon yacht. Some boats include features like wakeboard towers, swim platforms, and onboard BBQ and bar.

quotes.author: AnnaVancouver
quotes.text: Thank you so much for a great service and all the fun! We rented a boat for four people just before sunset and it was the best sunset watching experience I have had! I also highly recommend Denys as a captain for his sense of humor, responsiveness, and care.
